name: Numerical Methods
short_description: Root finding, numerical integration, differential equations, and floating point errors.
description: Numerical analysis for scientific computing: IEEE 754 floating point precision, root-finding (Newton-Raphson), interpolation, numerical quadrature, and Runge-Kutta ODE solvers.

courses.title: Numerical Methods & Scientific Computing
courses.description: Iterative algorithms, error analysis, numerical differentiation, and matrix solvers.

modules.title: Errors & Floating Point
modules.description: Where numerical error comes from and how it grows.

topics.title: Errors, Floating-Point Arithmetic & Stability
topics.summary: Absolute and relative error, round-off and truncation, conditioning, and stability.

modules.title: Root Finding & Non-linear Equations
modules.description: Bisection method, secant method, and Newton-Raphson quadratic convergence.

topics.title: Bisection & Secant Methods
topics.summary: Bracketing a root, convergence guarantees, and derivative-free iteration.

topics.title: Newton-Raphson & Fixed-Point Iteration
topics.summary: Derivative-based root approximation and convergence guarantees.

topics.title: Polynomial Interpolation: Lagrange & Newton
topics.summary: Interpolating polynomials, divided differences, and interpolation error.

modules.title: Numerical Integration & ODEs
modules.description: Trapezoidal rule, Simpson's 1/3 rule, and Euler/Runge-Kutta differential solvers.

topics.title: Numerical Integration: Trapezoidal & Simpson's Rules
topics.summary: Newton-Cotes formulas, composite rules, and their error terms.

topics.title: Runge-Kutta (RK4) Method
topics.summary: Fourth-order iterative stepping for initial value problems.

modules.title: Linear Systems
modules.description: Solving large linear systems by iteration.

topics.title: Iterative Methods for Linear Systems
topics.summary: Jacobi and Gauss-Seidel iteration, convergence, and comparison with LU factorization.
